d:
A major throwback to where it all began.
Uchda Burj Lahore Da was once how I opened my live shows — and this moment from Bhubaneswar takes me straight back down memory lane.
A sea of 60,000 people dancing together, singing every word, and celebrating music with pure joy. The love, the energy, and the connection that night were truly unforgettable.
Moments like these remind me why live music is magical — when hearts, rhythm, and memories come together as one.
Deep gratitude to every soul who was part of this night.
Forever thankful. Forever humbled. 🏻
